convert_llava_onevision_weights: convert a LLaVA-Onevision model checkpoint from the original repository to HuggingFace format
load_original_state_dict: load the original state dict from a LLaVA-Onevision model checkpoint stored as safetensors
convert_state_dict_to_hf: convert original state dict keys to HuggingFace model key naming convention
resize_token_embeddings_with_distributio: resize token embeddings for new image/video tokens using a multivariate normal distribution
